notes: Every field you type into now looks and behaves the same way, on both tabs. There were four different styles before, depending on which feature you happened to be in.
Amounts show a $ inside the box and are set larger, so the figure reads as the number it is instead of small text adrift in a wide field.
Fixed: Extra per month, Monthly budget and the amortization picker had no styling at all — they were plain browser boxes, which is why they showed up white in dark mode.
Fixed: the Bills and Sinking Funds fields had no background, from a colour referenced throughout the app but never actually defined.
